hindi.note: Standard PDF fonts lack Devanagari glyphs; requires fontkit embedding or canvas raster fallback.

scanned.note: When text items === 0, our PdfCanvas triggers isScannedDoc banner offering OCR.

forms.notes: PdfCanvas renders static PDF raster without AcroForm widget overlay. Forms menu in toolbar only has Check/Cross stamps, no form field creation or filling.

passwordProtected.notes: Editor.jsx catches error in loadPdf(file) with toast.error("Failed to parse PDF: " + e.message) but has NO password prompt modal to ask user for password.

rotatedPages.notes: PageThumbnails can rotate pages 90 deg via rotatePdf(), but PdfCanvas text extraction overlay does not properly account for rotated viewports when placing editing blocks on pre-rotated pages.
